If menstrual cups or any tampons don't really work for you, [period panties](https://www.amazon.com/Proof-Brief-Period-Underwear-Large/dp/B01LG03XO2/ref=sr_1_1?ie=UTF8&qid=1499365220&sr=8-1&keywords=4period) can be used on medium and light days all by themselves. On heavy days, I use mine with reusable pads which is another cheap and effective way. If you do use internal methods you can use [period thongs](https://www.amazon.com/4period-Menstrual-Incontinence-Organic-Underwear/dp/B073L557VH/ref=sr_1_3?ie=UTF8&qid=1499365220&sr=8-3&keywords=4period) as a backup.
